messages:
maria: Customer reported intermittent 401s on text-generation endpoints and a simultaneous unexplained billing spike. They attached a repro payload but it contains emails and customer SSNs — we need a sanitized repro + debug bundle. Request IDs they saw: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e. Any quick guidance? :frowning:
support-bot: Please confirm tenant/org ID and exact timestamps of the failures. Also ask the customer to run the debug collector for the specific request: `ri-debug collect --request r-0a1b2c3d` and attach the resulting bundle.
eli: I can pick this up once we have the bundle. @maria can you ask them to produce a sanitized curl that reproduces the 401 (we only need minimal headers/body). Example repro (PLEASE REPLACE API_KEY and emails before sending):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-xxl","input":"<PROMPT_WITHOUT_PII>","user":"<USER_ID_REDACTED>"}'
```
jessica: When they sanitize, please instruct them to: replace emails with `<EMAIL_REDACTED>`, replace SSNs with `<SSN_REDACTED>`, and redact any card numbers or IP addresses. Prefer `redwood-scrub` if available, otherwise a small sed pipeline works: `sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+/<EMAIL_REDACTED>/g' | sed -E 's/\b[0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}\b/<SSN_REDACTED>/g'`.
sre-oncall: Also tell them to capture the client-side request headers and the server trace around the failure time. For 401s include the `Authorization` header but replace token with `REDACTED`. If they can, include the server-side trace id and any `X-Request-ID` returned. A typical server log snippet we need: `auth: token expired` or `auth: invalid audience` — that helps narrow whether it's an auth issue vs. routing.
maria: Good call. They also asked whether we need billing/invoice info — they saw a usage charge jump at the same time as the 401s.
eli: Include invoice id and timestamp (redact card PAN). Billing team prefers `invoice:<INVOICE_ID>` and a CSV of the API usage rows around that timestamp. Don't include full card numbers.
jessica: For debug bundle collection use the CLI with sanitize mode so we don't accidentally include raw emails: `ri-debug collect --request r-0a1b2c3d --include-logs --sanitize --output debugbundle-1798001234.tar.gz`. That produces a scrubbed bundle we can ingest. If they can't run the CLI, have them run the sanitized curl above and paste both request/response headers and the small body.
maria: I'll send the sanitized repro instructions + the exact CLI command to the customer and ask them to upload the resulting debug bundle via the secure upload link (or DM it to support if they prefer). Any other data points we should ask for?
sre-oncall: Ask them to note the client timezone and approximate RTT. If latency spiked before the 401s, that can hint at token refresh race conditions. Also request the SDK version or the curl user-agent string.
maria: Perfect. I'll gather those fields: sanitized curl, debug bundle, invoice id (redacted), and timestamps. I'll follow up here when bundle is uploaded. Thanks :thumbsup:
